definitions.gloss: ballot counting; vote counting; opening of ballots
definitions.explanation: The process of opening and counting votes after an election.

examples.japanese: {開票|かいひょう}が{始|はじ}まった。
{開票|かいひょう}{速報|そくほう}をテレビで{見|み}ていた。
examples.english: I was watching the vote-counting updates on TV.

examples.japanese: {深夜|しんや}まで{開票|かいひょう}{作業|さぎょう}が{続|つづ}き、ようやく{結果|けっか}が{確定|かくてい}した。
examples.english: The ballot-counting work continued until late at night, and the results were finally confirmed.

notes:
Literally 'opening ({開|かい}) ballots ({票|ひょう})' — the process of opening ballot boxes and counting votes after an election.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開票|かいひょう}する (to count ballots)
- {開票|かいひょう}{速報|そくほう} (vote-counting flash report)
- {開票|かいひょう}{作業|さぎょう} (ballot-counting work)
- {開票|かいひょう}{結果|けっか} (counting results)
- {開票|かいひょう}{率|りつ} (percentage of ballots counted)
- {即日|そくじつ}{開票|かいひょう} (same-day ballot counting)

ELECTION VOCABULARY SERIES:
- {投票|とうひょう}: casting a vote
- {開票|かいひょう}: counting votes
- {得票|とくひょう}: votes received (by a candidate)
- {当選|とうせん}: winning an election
- {落選|らくせん}: losing an election
